Comment: SOC-in-a-Box Incident Response Playbook (Express). Notify → Route → Document.

Notify.Comment: Send SNS alert immediately. Responders get notified within seconds of detection.

RouteByDetectionType.Comment: Route HIGH severity findings to containment Lambda. MEDIUM goes straight to logging.

ContainAndDocument.Comment: Invoke the contain-identity Lambda which: queries Athena for recent activity, attaches a Deny policy to the offending identity, and writes the incident record to S3.

LogFinding.Comment: MEDIUM severity or containment failed — log the finding for manual review. The SNS notification already went out above.

IncidentComplete.Comment: Playbook complete. Check SNS for the alert and CloudWatch Logs for Lambda execution details.
